description: Named the finger, and offered to carry the letter.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Laid the loaf to the notch and priced the meat at threepence.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Took the heel and did not hurry the post.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Sat three rows ahead and did not speak.
name: Sir John Spencer

description: Preached on the light and was not brief.
name: Master Josias Thwaite

description: Ate, refused the errand, and left the letter unwritten until after dinner.
name: William Shakespeare
